problem: Two distinct Portfolio derived job IDs currently carry the same durable dedupe_key (`jose:v11-map-density-refinement:v1`). Because PIN ownership is stored under job_id-specific paths, duplicate semantic work can appear independently claimable even when the dedupe identity is identical.
acceptance: A deterministic repo-derived check groups seed and derived Portfolio rows by dedupe_key and reports every nonterminal duplicate identity with all job IDs and evidence refs.

Allocation or materialization rejects or quarantines additional nonterminal rows that reuse an existing dedupe_key so two job IDs cannot become independently PINnable representations of the same semantic work.

A regression fixture covers portfolio-jose-v11-map-density-refinement-v1 and portfolio-jose-v11-map-refinement sharing jose:v11-map-density-refinement:v1 and proves one semantic identity remains allocatable.
The repair preserves append-only PIN and RETURN history and does not promote Current, Human Accepted, Served, or production authority.
title: Enforce Portfolio dedupe-key uniqueness across derived jobs
mission: Add a bounded validation/materialization guard so Portfolio derived rows cannot create multiple independently PINnable job paths for one semantic dedupe_key, while preserving existing append-only evidence and authority boundaries.

collision_reduction.reason: Semantic duplicates should collapse before job-id-scoped PIN ownership can diverge.

regression_prevention.reason: A deterministic invariant and fixture make duplicate dedupe_key materialization observable instead of relying on manual worker inspection.

human_friction_reduction.reason: Workers no longer need to compare differently named Portfolio rows manually to discover they represent the same semantic work.

goal_relevance.reason: Reliable semantic deduplication improves autonomous /wc allocation without adding human routing or weakening append-only ownership evidence.

falsification: Two distinct nonterminal derived job IDs with the same dedupe_key can still both be emitted as normally claimable.
The guard silently deletes or rewrites historical PIN or RETURN evidence instead of preserving append-only history.
The check relies on job title similarity rather than the durable dedupe_key field.
The change promotes product authority or Current/Served state instead of remaining a coordination invariant.
dedup_note: This is distinct from the capability-safe Portfolio frontier proposal: that proposal preserves required_capabilities for worker-specific selection; this proposal enforces uniqueness of the semantic dedupe identity across differently named Portfolio rows before independent job-id PIN paths can diverge.
